Definition: from G4314 and a derivative of G58 (mean to harangue); to address, i.e. salute by name:--call.
BiblicalUsage: Prosagoreuo means to be called or addressed by name, and it appears once, of Christ Himself. Hebrews says He was called of God an high priest after the order of Melchisedec.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Christ did not take the priesthood for Himself; God named Him to it, and that is why His priesthood stands forever.
